name: 28695-mtpdecode-qwen35-35ba3bfp8-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8, the checkpoint's own block-wise-FP8 release. Ungated; ~35 GB of weights across 14 safetensors shards, and the FP8 release rather than bf16 because ~70 GiB of bf16 weights does not fit this card.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration, a GDN-hybrid MoE: 40 decoder layers at full_attention_interval 4 (30 linear-attention, 10 full attention), 256 routed experts plus one shared at top-8, ~35B total / ~3B active, block-wise FP8; the checkpoint also ships a vision tower and a one-layer MTP head.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 512 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. streams matches `--max-running-requests 64`, which is the admission ceiling, so it may be walked down within [8, 64] but never above.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no shared prefix: 512 prompt tokens (stdev 0) against 2048 output tokens (stdev 0), `ignore_eos` true, temperature 0.0, seed 28695. Prompts must stay unique; the prefix cache is off.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating 2048-token answers from short prompts for 64 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang server arguments. Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser.
# A bool is a FLAG: `true` emits `--key`, `false` emits nothing. host/port/served-model-name are
# set by the serving layer, not here.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8
tp-size: 1

# The draft model is the checkpoint's own MTP head, so no draft path is set: the draft worker
# falls back to the target's model path by itself. Do not add `speculative-adaptive` -- its default
# config turns drafting off entirely at some batch sizes.
speculative-algorithm: NEXTN
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

disable-radix-cache: true

# Not optional: any speculative algorithm resets `max_running_requests` to 48 when it is unset.
max-running-requests: 64

context-length: 4096
attention-backend: fa3
cuda-graph-max-bs-decode: 64
mem-fraction-static: 0.82
random-seed: 28695
